name: Diagnostics - Yandex AI Studio Connection Test

parameters.jsCode: const input=$input.first().json;const fail=(code,message)=>[{json:{valid:false,result:{ok:false,provider:'yandex',model:typeof input.model==='string'?input.model:'',modelDiscovery:'not-run',completionShape:'not-run',error:{code,message,retryable:false,httpStatus:null},warnings:[]}}}];if(input.baseUrl!=='https://ai.api.cloud.yandex.net/v1')return fail('CONFIGURATION_ERROR','Yandex API Base URL is not allowlisted');if(typeof input.folderId!=='string'||!/^[a-z0-9]{20}$/.test(input.folderId))return fail('CONFIGURATION_ERROR','Yandex folder ID is not configured');if(typeof input.model!=='string')return fail('CONFIGURATION_ERROR','Yandex model URI is not configured');const match=input.model.match(new RegExp('^gpt://([a-z0-9]{20})/[A-Za-z0-9._@/-]{1,220}$'));if(!match||match[1]!==input.folderId)return fail('CONFIGURATION_ERROR','Yandex model URI must use the configured folder');return [{json:{valid:true,baseUrl:input.baseUrl,folderId:input.folderId,model:input.model}}];

const response=$input.first().json;const profile=$('Validate Yandex Connection Profile').first().json;const status=Number(response.statusCode??0);const body=response.body??response;const fail=(code,message,retryable=false)=>[{json:{ready:false,result:{ok:false,provider:'yandex',model:profile.model,modelDiscovery:'failed',completionShape:'not-run',error:{code,message,retryable,httpStatus:status||null},warnings:[]}}}];if(status===401||status===403)return fail('AUTH_FAILED','Yandex model discovery authentication or permission failed');if(status===408)return fail('PROVIDER_TIMEOUT','Yandex model discovery timed out',true);if(status===429)return fail('RATE_LIMITED','Yandex model discovery rate limit exceeded',true);if(status===0||status>=500)return fail('PROVIDER_UNAVAILABLE','Yandex model discovery is unavailable',true);if(status<200||status>=300||!Array.isArray(body?.data))return fail('INVALID_PROVIDER_RESPONSE','Yandex models response is invalid');const models=body.data.map(item=>item?.id).filter(id=>typeof id==='string');if(!models.includes(profile.model))return fail('MODEL_NOT_FOUND','Configured Yandex model is not available to this folder');return [{json:{ready:true,baseUrl:profile.baseUrl,folderId:profile.folderId,model:profile.model,modelDiscovery:'available',modelCount:models.length}}];

const response=$input.first().json;const discovery=$('Normalize Yandex Model Discovery').first().json;const status=Number(response.statusCode??0);const body=response.body??response;let code=null;let message=null;if(status===401||status===403){code='AUTH_FAILED';message='Yandex completion authentication or permission failed';}else if(status===404||(status===400&&/(model|uri)/i.test(JSON.stringify(body)))){code='MODEL_NOT_FOUND';message='Configured Yandex model is unavailable';}else if(status===408){code='PROVIDER_TIMEOUT';message='Yandex completion timed out';}else if(status===429){code='RATE_LIMITED';message='Yandex completion rate limit exceeded';}else if(status===0||status>=500){code='PROVIDER_UNAVAILABLE';message='Yandex completion is unavailable';}else if(status<200||status>=300||typeof body?.choices?.[0]?.message?.content!=='string'){code='INVALID_PROVIDER_RESPONSE';message='Yandex completion response is invalid';}return [{json:{ok:code===null,provider:'yandex',model:discovery.model,modelDiscovery:'available',completionShape:code===null?'valid':'invalid',error:code?{code,message,retryable:['PROVIDER_TIMEOUT','RATE_LIMITED','PROVIDER_UNAVAILABLE'].includes(code),httpStatus:status||null}:null,warnings:[]}}];

parameters.content:
## Yandex connection test
- Configure the exact folder and full model URI before binding the credential.
- Credential: HTTP Header Auth, `Authorization: Api-Key <secret>`.
- The test first calls official `/models`; it stops on missing `yc.ai.models.viewer`, wrong folder, or unavailable model.
- It then sends one non-personal minimal completion.
- Reports never include response bodies, prompts, headers, or credential values.
